traversalsNote: Game uu. Ropes, ziplines, teleporters and jumps measured on the scene: a and b are the walk-grid cells at the two ends (they become roadmap nodes joined by a link in <map>.nav.json), zones the zone at each end. See tools/map-mesh/README.md.

traversals.name: A Shop <-> Mid Hall rope
traversals.basis: Game metres. Rope under the ascender Kingdom_0_VertAscenderA (x,y 27.48, 25.96; housing z 14.18..14.63). a = the walk cell at its foot, b = the nearest cell of the floor it reaches. Both ends are on the main floor: the rope is a short cut.
traversals.provenance: measured-on-mesh (object position, the two walk cells, length 4.74 m); manual-approx (travel time = length / 6.75 m/s — speed assumed equal to the movement model's run speed (6.75 m/s): the game's rope / zipline speed was not measured; that the object is a usable rope: object name and game knowledge)

objectsNote: Game uu. Doors and breakables located on the scene: position is on the floor in the opening, normal the horizontal direction through it. Read by tools/map-mesh/pipeline/objects_map.py.

objects.name: Sliding hatch (A_Tunnel)

objects.provenance: measured-on-mesh (the two objects); manual-approx (that this is the hatch of the one-way chute named in mechanics: object names and collection Foxtrot_Art_A_Tunnel only)
